`onnx_ml_pb2.py` is the unmodified generated Python protobuf schema from
ONNX 1.17.0 (onnx/onnx-ml.proto). Its Apache-2.0 license is in `ONNX_LICENSE`.
The schema is used only to read an exported model and extract the diagnostic
visual subgraph in memory. No ONNX native extension or model conversion is used.
